description: E1 with negative-eigenvalue Gated DeltaNet: identical layout and recipe to E1, but every GDN layer uses beta = 2*sigmoid(b(x)) in (0, 2) instead of sigmoid in (0, 1) (fla allow_neg_eigval). One change vs E1. Motivated by SQ6 arm (e): 100% parity in one pass, length-generalising (ledger C43). Run at E1's tuned LR from K7, same seeds as E1's replication.
